title: A multi-speaker dataset of real-time two-dimensional speech magnetic resonance images with articulator ground-truth segmentations
task: counting 1-10 once at self-selected normal speaking rate
token_or_recording_size: 5 MRI series; 392 frames; 392 manual masks; 392 velopharyngeal-closure labels
manual_scope: GT masks were manually pixel-labelled for every frame; closure was independently labelled by four MRI physicists with majority vote as GT
decision_reason: Primary non-singing speech-production imaging with exhaustive human-created articulatory ground truth and frame-level manual closure judgments; public archive has authoritative checksum and documented one-to-one frame/mask structure.
evidence_summary: Zenodo documents five healthy adults, 392 0.1-s rt-MRI frames, manual six-class articulator masks for each frame, and four-rater visual velopharyngeal-closure classification. Dataset structure and coding are explicit; archive is 21.9 MB with MD5 2c5fb95e6294ecf97204f64128137a96.
